verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a self-hosted open-source Python library, so most 'data' (agent state, message history) lives in the user's own process as plain Python/JSON objects rather than being locked in a vendor platform, and docs note message history is accessible for both continuing conversations and analysis. However, there is no explicit documented 'export all your data and leave' feature, and the optional hosted Logfire/AI-Gateway services (which do store traces/evals) have no documented bulk-export mechanism in the evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export tool/format for hosted Logfire traces and evals, and any documented account/data portability guarantee for the hosted services.
